name: @textfilters/phone
description: TypeScript phone number and phone-like sequence detector for moderation pipelines with false-positive guards.

scripts.lint: prettier README.md docs package.json src tests scripts --check
scripts.format: prettier README.md docs package.json src tests scripts --write
scripts.smoke:dist: node --input-type=module --eval "const phone = await import('./dist/index.js'); if (!phone.filter.check('+1 555 123 4567')) throw new Error('Smoke check failed'); phone.filter.censor('+1 555 123 4567', '#');"
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm test && npm run build && npm run smoke:dist && npm run pack:dry-run
